# Muse Invite Codes F8R3CV and NVA0AS

> This page lists two Muse invite codes, F8R3CV and NVA0AS, shared by the site owner. Use one code only; one Muse account can redeem a single invite code.

Key facts (last updated 2026-11-12):
- Product: Muse, a personal AI agent
- Join link: https://muse.ai/join
- Invite codes: F8R3CV, NVA0AS (choose one, not stackable)
- Redemption deadline: within 48 hours of joining Muse
- Mobile redemption: Muse app, Settings > Redeem token
- Web redemption: muse.ai, Settings > General > Usage > Redeem invite code
- Reward per the invitation screen checked on 2026-11-12: 1 billion Muse tokens for the inviter and 1 billion Muse tokens for the invitee after a successful redemption
- Privacy: using an invite code does not give the inviter access to the invitee's chats
- Status: codes have limited spots; this site is updated when they run out
